00146 float Env::lookup(float time) const throw()
00147 {
00148  const int numTimes = getTimes().size();
00149  const int numLevels = getLevels().size();
00150  const int lastLevel = numLevels-1;
00151  
00152  ugen_assert(numTimes == lastLevel);
00153  
00154  if(numLevels < 1) return 0.f;
00155  if(time <= 0.f || numTimes == 0) return getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(0);
00156  
00157  float lastTime = 0.f;
00158  float stageTime = 0.f;
00159  int stageIndex = 0;
00160  
00161  while(stageTime < time && stageIndex < numTimes)
00162  {
00163   lastTime = stageTime;
00164   stageTime += getTimes().getSampleUnchecked(stageIndex);
00165   stageIndex++;
00166  }
00167  
00168  if(stageIndex > numTimes) return getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(lastLevel);
00169   
00170  float level0 = getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(stageIndex-1);
00171  float level1 = getLevels().getSampleUnchecked(stageIndex);
00172  
00173  EnvCurve curve = getCurves()[stageIndex-1];
00174  EnvCurve::CurveType type = curve.getType();
00175  float curveValue = curve.getCurve();
00176  
00177  if((lastTime - stageTime)==0.f)
00178  {
00179     return level1;
00180  }
00181  else if(type == EnvCurve::Linear)
00182  {
00183   return linlin(time, lastTime, stageTime, level0, level1);
00184  }
00185  else if(type == EnvCurve::Numerical)
00186  {
00187   if(abs(curveValue) <= 0.001)
00188   {
00189    return linlin(time, lastTime, stageTime, level0, level1);
00190   }
00191   else
00192   {   
00193    float pos = (time-lastTime) / (stageTime-lastTime);
00194    float denom = 1.f - std::exp(curveValue);
00195    float numer = 1.f - std::exp(pos * curveValue);
00196    return level0 + (level1 - level0) * (numer/denom);
00197   }
00198  }
00199  else if(type == EnvCurve::Sine)
00200  {
00201   return linsin(time, lastTime, stageTime, level0, level1);
00202  }
00203  else if(type == EnvCurve::Exponential)
00204  {
00205   return linexp(time, lastTime, stageTime, level0, level1);
00206  }
00207  else if(type == EnvCurve::Welch)
00208  {
00209   return linwelch(time, lastTime, stageTime, level0, level1);
00210  }
00211  else
00212  {
00213   // Empty or Step
00214   return level1;
00215  }
00216 }

00218 Env::operator Buffer () const throw()
00219 {
00220  const float duration = getTimes().sum();
00221  const int size = UGen::getSampleRate() * duration;
00222  Buffer buffer = BufferSpec(size, 1, false);
00223  float *bufferSamples = buffer.getData();
00224  
00225  double time = 0.0;
00226  for(int i = 0; i < size; i++, time += UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate())
00227  {
00228   *bufferSamples++ = lookup(time);
00229  }
00230  
00231  return buffer;
00232 }
00233 
00234 void Env::writeToBuffer(Buffer& buffer, const int channel) const throw()
00235 {
00236  const double duration = getTimes().sum();
00237  const int size = buffer.size();
00238  
00239  ugen_assert(size > 0);
00240  ugen_assert(buffer.getNumChannels() > 0);
00241  
00242  float *bufferSamples = buffer.getData(channel % buffer.getNumChannels());
00243  
00244  const double timeInc = duration / size;
00245  double time = 0.0;
00246  for(int i = 0; i < size; i++, time += timeInc)
00247  {
00248   *bufferSamples++ = lookup(time);
00249  }
00250 }

00252 Env Env::linen(const double attackTime, 
00253       const double sustainTime, 
00254       const double releaseTime, 
00255       const double sustainLevel,
00256       EnvCurve const& curve) throw()
00257 {
00258  ugen_assert(attackTime >= 0.0);
00259  ugen_assert(sustainTime >= 0.0);
00260  ugen_assert(releaseTime >= 0.0);
00261  ugen_assert(sustainLevel >= 0.0);
00262  ugen_assert((attackTime + sustainTime + releaseTime) > 0.0);
00263  
00264  return Env(Buffer(0.0, sustainLevel, sustainLevel, 0.0), 
00265       Buffer(attackTime, sustainTime, releaseTime),
00266       curve);
00267 }
